result.summary: Review of target d428e0f7 (feature/binary-config-serve-20260930) for worker deadlines, token-progress idle detection, scheduler quiescence and false recovery detection. Verdict FINDINGS. HIGH: a control intent persisted at coordinator.ts:833 that keeps failing in applyControl is never cleared, and step() returns at coordinator.ts:440 before the deadline check (452) and the token-idle budget (612-626), so an expired deadline never fires, OpenCode is never stopped, dispatches are never delivered or collected, and cancel/destroy/force-destroy plus send_worker_message all refuse to clear it; control() even answers success. MEDIUM: the deadline is enforced before monitor(), so a turn that already settled with a valid result is torn down as 'Worker task timed out' and its result is discarded. LOW: the 30s reconcile is awaited inline before the step fan-out, deferring all budget enforcement behind two API timeouts. Findings 1 and 2 reproduced with local fakes; baseline 25 pass/0 fail, probes 6 pass/0 fail. Artifacts: /workspace/.swarmforge/artifacts/review.md and findings.json.
result.details:
Target d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895 verified in a disposable detached clone at /tmp/rev08/target; /workspace/repo left at assigned baseline 5672ead and clean. The delta vs baseline only adds shutdown/tick tracking in coordinator.ts, so findings are existing-code defects.

F1 HIGH (reproduced, src/coordinator.ts:440, 452, 612-626, 510-526, 833, 828-829): runControl persists intent then calls step; step's first branch applies the intent and returns, so a persistently failing pauseWorker/resumeWorker re-enters applyControl forever. The catch patches error but never clears intent, so state stays running with pending_control while an expired deadline_at and an expired token_progress_at are never enforced, systemctl stop is never issued, the queued dispatch is never delivered, and cancel/destroy are refused ('Another worker control operation is pending'); a restart does not help because the intent is durable and runRecover skips workers with one. control() resolves successfully, masking the failure. Probe /tmp/rev08/probe/deadline-intent.test.ts: 3 of 4 tests cover F1, control test proves the deadline path works with no intent pending.

F2 MEDIUM (reproduced, src/coordinator.ts:452 vs 486-509, 610-611): the deadline check precedes monitor(), the only path that settles a turn, so a turn that finished and wrote a valid result is failed/recovery_required with 'Worker task timed out', its dispatch cancelled and its result discarded; claimDispatch (src/store.ts:251-264) starts the deadline at claim, so delivery and Git time also consume it. Probe /tmp/rev08/probe/deadline-settle.test.ts plus an unexpired-deadline control.

F3 LOW (code-evidenced, src/coordinator.ts:311): runTick awaits recover() before the per-worker step fan-out; runRecover awaits listWorkers and one getWorker per worker at API_TIMEOUT each, so a degraded API defers all deadline/idle enforcement by roughly two timeouts while the ticking guard skips polls.

Sound and checked: pause/resume budget shifting, durable idle clock across restarts, max-monotonic recordProgress, idle-stop quiesce/retention, sessionStatus never treating an unrecognized type as settled, no false completion without a completed reply or run_id-matched result.json, ambiguous-delivery escalation only on idle plus absent history.

Limits: fakes only, no live provider/model/VM, no full suite, no build; F3 not executed. Probe files live only under /tmp (disclosed). No credentials used or emitted.
